policy_manifest:
{
  "version": "touchstone.policy-manifest.v1",
  "policy_id": "nav-settlement",
  "policy_version": 1,
  "asset_key": "eip155:1:0x43415eb6ff9db7e26a15b704e7a3edce97d31c4e",
  "title": "NAV settlement",
  "consumer_question": "Has the net asset value this asset would be lent against actually settled? A collateral desk cannot price against a figure the issuer may restate tomorrow, so this policy requires a NAV row confirmed unchanged by a capture at least a day older and at least two business days settled. It deliberately asks for more than disclosure freshness, and will refuse when freshness alone would pass.",
  "controls": [
    "ustb-nav-daily-freshness",
    "ustb-nav-per-share-present"
